scope: Damaged copies of one stock map per profile (q3, ql, rtcw-sp, rtcw-mp) loaded by the fnTech3 client: every lump moved past the end, to -4, one byte long and 2 GB long, four header and truncation faults, and 32 seeded byte corruptions, one lump at a time.

probe.lastChangedBy: the commit that adds this record

client.platform: Windows 11 x64 host, Windows x86 build: meson/build/win32-dev, MSVC 19.44, debugoptimized, strict warnings, renderers glx/vk/rtx as modules; RTCW, WolfET and Elite Force development gates on
client.source: 3089df2 with the grid guard of 5ba3561, built from the working tree

faultSites.fntech3.exe@6f4e6c: memset in Hunk_Alloc, from CMod_LoadLeafs or CMod_LoadSubmodels
faultSites.fnql_glx_x86.dll@bd4f9: R_PointInLeaf+0x49, from the surface-light proxies in RE_LoadWorldMap

faultSitesBasis: ln against the PDBs of the build that ran; reproductions under cdb gave full stacks for R_SetParent, R_PointInLeaf, R_AddWorldSurface, Hunk_Alloc from CMod_LoadLeafs and from CMod_LoadSubmodels, and CM_BoundBrush in CMod_LoadBrushes
environment: Windowed on unswitched private desktops (tests/windows_private_process.py), one fresh process and isolated fs_homepath per run under .tmp/probe-records/, sound and mouse/joystick input disabled, Steam integration and the WebUI off, loopback UDP only, console commands only. Retail installations were read, never written. GLx renderer, pure off, bots off, sv_errorExit 0.
